pages.title: Browser
pages.one: A helper reads public web pages in its own private browser per ticket; only sites you allow open.

steps.text: You turn the add-on on and download the browser once
steps.detail: Only a person runs the download. Until the add-on is on, helpers do not see it. The browser is a separate program (an .exe on Windows); a company computer that blocks new programs blocks this add-on, and the rest of orch works without it.

steps.text: You add the sites a ticket may open to its site list
steps.detail: The list belongs to the person: a helper cannot add to it. It asks on the ticket when it needs a site that is missing.

steps.text: A helper opens a page for its ticket
steps.detail: orch starts a fresh browser for that ticket with an empty temporary profile, never your own browser or a saved one.

steps.text: The network filter checks every connection
steps.detail: Only sites on the list, only ports 80 and 443, and never this computer, the local network or cloud metadata, also after a redirect. A missing or damaged list allows nothing; there is no way around the filter.

branch.if: the site is not on the list, or a check fails
branch.then: it is stopped and named as not loaded

branch.if: the site is on the list and every check passes

steps.text: Gives the helper the page text and numbered links and buttons
steps.detail: orch marks page text as written by the site: the helper treats it as content, never as an instruction.

steps.text: The helper reads, clicks links, tabs and show more, or types a search
steps.detail: It only reads: forms that send, logging in, password fields, uploads and downloads are stopped. The helper never works around that with another browser or a script; it says on the ticket what it could not do.

steps.text: Closes the browser and deletes its temporary profile
steps.detail: When the helper closes it, after 15 minutes without a command, or when the filter or the browser stops. Pictures the helper saved stay in their own folder.

good: One browser per ticket, deleted at the end: no sign-in, cookie or history stays behind.
No AI call in the filter: a program decides each connection and writes it to the ticket's network log.

cmds: start the ticket's browser and open a page
the page again: text and numbered elements
click element n (links, tabs, show more)
close it; its temporary profile is deleted
allow a site for one ticket (a person only)
download the browser once (a person only)
files: the site list of each ticket
each connection: host, port, allowed or not, why
pictures a helper saved of a page
